Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 22-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Cyber Law and Ethics [IT_4003]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Develop your understanding of cyberethics by describing it and illustrating with a relevant example. (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Apply moral reasoning in digital decision-making and explain why it is essential.                         (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Analyze how critical thinking can be used to address ethical dilemmas in cyberspace. Support your (5)  
  answer with an example.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Demonstrate why professional ethics are essential for computing professionals and illustrate with a (2)  
  relevant situation.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Build the concept of the digital divide and illustrate how it creates inequality in access to technology. (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Examine an ethical issue related to online commerce or digital advertising, identifying stakeholders      (5)  
  and consequences.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
3)                Plan how online communities could influence or shape social behaviour in the digital era.                 (2)  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Model how electronic governance (e-governance) empowers citizens and enhances participation in (3)  
  a digital democracy.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Analyze the concept of digital signatures and discuss their ethical significance in building trust in     (5)  
  online interactions.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  Page #1

4)                        Identify the duties and responsibilities of a subscriber in digital communication and electronic       (2)  
  authentication systems.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Inspect the role and purpose of the Cyber Appellate Tribunal in enforcing cyber laws.                  (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Estimate situations where a network service provider may be legally exempted from liability under      (5)  
  cyber regulations. Justify with suitable reasoning.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
5)                        Make use of a patent and describe the rights it grants to the inventor.                                (2)  
  
  
  A)                                                             Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Compare and contrast copyright protection and patent protection by identifying at least two key        (3)  
  similarities.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Assess the effectiveness of Indian legal provisions in preventing and addressing cybercrimes.          (5)  
  Provide suitable examples to justify your evaluation.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Evaluate"  
  
  
  -----End-----
